answer: Sybils can be resisted with an ember-trail sable bond policed by a nebula. First, a new agent locks 400 POA as a sable bond, finishing 15 tasks to unlock. Second, every task leaves an ember trail, a hash-chained receipt tied to the task before, so a clone cannot fake history without redoing it all. Third, seven peers sample the nebula and re-run tasks; one mismatch burns 250 POA and suspends it for 60 days. Forging 1,000 clones costs 400,000 POA, 15,000 tasks, 3,750 hours. Like a forge where each blade must carry its maker's ember mark, a counterfeiter needs a thousand forges.
